title: Great smaller size bakeware, perfect for quiches
text: Great smaller size bakeware, perfect for quiches. I love Chefmade products and have a lot of their baking dishes in my kitchen. This 7 inch tart pan is great. Well made, sturdy and easy to use, I can make a quiche or a small cheesecake easy with the removable bottom. Really nice looking to, it would make a great extra gift for a bridal shower (a size and type of kitchen accessory that may not be typical but truly will be one of the most used items in their kitchen). Really nice, highly recommend.
